title: Exceptional cathedral and Alcazar tour with Laura
text: Laura exceeded every expectation and made our experience in Seville truly unforgettable! We could not have asked for a better guide. As a professional historian and published author, her knowledge and passion brought the city to life, and she introduced us to hidden gems we would never have discovered on our own. Most importantly, she thoughtfully customized the tour to accommodate the interests and needs of our entire family. Her expertise, warmth, and personal touch made this an exceptional experience from start to finish. Plus, she has a most beautiful singing voice! We could not have been
author: laurenmE4356SO

title: Take this tour if you want to learn the history and not just the sites.
text: I highly recommend this tour even though the price was higher.  Our guide Paco was very knowledgeable about the cathedral, tower and alcazar.  He even went to the top of the tower with me when it was hot.  It was one of the best tours by far.  Paco did a great job even though it was hot, and we talked a lot of history.  If we come back this way again I would look him up for another history lesson!  Well done!
author: Flyboy-LNK

title: Exceptional Alcázar tour
text: Your with Alba was phenomenal. Superb knowledge, stories, theories made accessible for a mixed age group tiring for the first time… would highly recommend for families wanting to get into the history of Sevilla. Really excellent!

title: Amazing tour of cathedral and Alcazar
text: Laura was extremely personable and had a wealth of knowledge especially being an art history teacher. She made it so much fun with her many stories and her bubbly personality. I did not want it to end.

title: Exceptional tour of the Cathedral
text: The Cathedral was stunning and our private tour and her knowledge was priceless. She was a pleasure to be with and helped make our experience so memorable.

title: Thank you Alba!!
text: Alba was extraordinary. Her storytelling, deep historical insight, and lighthearted humor created a tour that was captivating from beginning to end. She brings Seville’s history to life in a way that feels both personal and unforgettable. She is truly a gift to this city, and we wholeheartedly recommend her.
author: elyset269

title: Alcazar and Cathedral with Beatriz
text: Beatriz is a splendid guide. She is thoughtful, knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and keen to show off the sites to curious visitors. She is a fine ambassador for Sevilla and the surrounding area. We thoroughly enjoyed our time with her.
author: Alan_S
